task_description: Speak a message with a text-to-speech tool.
Read the metadata of a media file with exiftool.
Switch the power profile to one of: performance, balanced, saver.
Return the disk-usage line for a given mount point.
Search a directory for files whose content matches a pattern.
Calculate the checksum of a file with a system tool.
List the running processes whose name contains a search term.
Look up WHOIS information for a domain.
Compare two lists of installed package names.
Show the system journal since a given date.
